panels.alt: MX Modular stereo AUX and BUS controls

items.name: AUX send
items.label: SEND
items.text: Sets the level sent from AUX 1/2 to internal FX 1/2 and to external devices.

items.name: AUX return
items.label: RETURN
items.text: Sets the level returned from internal FX 1/2 and an external device back into the console.

items.name: BUS send
items.label: SEND
items.text: Sets the signal level sent to the stereo bus output.

items.name: BUS return
items.label: RETURN
items.text: Sets the signal level returned from external devices or routing paths.

items.name: BUS insert
items.label: BUS INSERT EXT
items.text: Activates an insert, routing the bus through external processors or outboard gear.
